def test_submit_convergence_mirror_ancestor_e2e_fast_forwards(tmp_path):
    import subprocess

    def run(cwd, *args):
        return subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", *args],
            cwd=cwd,
            text=True,
        ).strip()

    remote = tmp_path / "remote.git"
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"

    subprocess.check_call(["git", "init", "--bare", "-q", str(remote)])
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "clone", "-q", str(remote), str(repo)])

    run(repo, "config", "user.email", "worker@edarsahub.local")
    run(repo, "config", "user.name", "EDARSAHUB Worker")

    (repo / "README.md").write_text("A\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(repo, "add", "README.md")
    run(repo, "commit", "-qm", "A")
    run(repo, "branch", "-M", "Edarsahub_Desarrollo")

    run(repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo")
    run(repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/mirror/emergent-live")

    (repo / "README.md").write_text("B\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(repo, "commit", "-qam", "B")

    development = run(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")

    run(repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo")

    from tools.mirror_sync.git_divergence_guard import (
        ensure_submit_convergence,
    )

    result = ensure_submit_convergence(
        repo,
        job_id="CONVERGENCE-E2E-CANARY",
        owner="test",
    )

    assert result["status"] == "FAST_FORWARDED_PASS"
    assert result["classification"] == "SYNC"
    assert result["converged"] is True
    assert result["safe"] is True
    assert result["auto_fix_applied"] is True
    assert result["local"] == development
    assert result["development"] == development
    assert result["mirror_after"] == development
    assert result["worktree_dirty"] is False


def test_submit_convergence_mirror_ahead_e2e_blocks(tmp_path):
    import subprocess

    def run(cwd, *args):
        return subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", *args],
            cwd=cwd,
            text=True,
        ).strip()

    remote = tmp_path / "remote.git"
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"

    subprocess.check_call(["git", "init", "--bare", "-q", str(remote)])
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "clone", "-q", str(remote), str(repo)])

    run(repo, "config", "user.email", "worker@edarsahub.local")
    run(repo, "config", "user.name", "EDARSAHUB Worker")

    (repo / "README.md").write_text("A\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(repo, "add", "README.md")
    run(repo, "commit", "-qm", "A")
    run(repo, "branch", "-M", "Edarsahub_Desarrollo")

    run(repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo")
    run(repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/mirror/emergent-live")

    (repo / "README.md").write_text("B\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(repo, "commit", "-qam", "B")
    dev = run(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")

    run(repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo")

    mirror_repo = tmp_path / "mirror"
    subprocess.check_call(
        ["git", "clone", "-q", str(remote), str(mirror_repo)]
    )

    run(mirror_repo, "config", "user.email", "worker@edarsahub.local")
    run(mirror_repo, "config", "user.name", "EDARSAHUB Worker")
    run(mirror_repo, "fetch", "-q", "origin", "mirror/emergent-live")
    run(mirror_repo, "checkout", "-q", "-B",
        "mirror-test", "origin/mirror/emergent-live")

    (mirror_repo / "README.md").write_text("C\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(mirror_repo, "commit", "-qam", "C")

    run(mirror_repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/mirror/emergent-live")

    run(repo, "fetch", "-q", "origin",
        "Edarsahub_Desarrollo", "mirror/emergent-live")

    from tools.mirror_sync.git_divergence_guard import (
        ensure_submit_convergence,
    )

    result = ensure_submit_convergence(
        repo,
        job_id="CONVERGENCE-E2E-MIRROR-AHEAD",
        owner="test",
    )

    assert result["status"] == "BLOCKED_MIRROR_AHEAD"
    assert result["converged"] is False
    assert result["safe"] is False
    assert result["auto_fix_applied"] is False
